text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having run with all her might in the 
Junior Cup, Mejiro Ryan rejoices upon 
securing her ticket to the stage she has 
dreamed of.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Immediately after, a massive cheer erupted 
from the TV broadcast showing another 
racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Broadcast on the television screen was the 
sight of Ines Fujin claiming a dominant 
runaway victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan received Ines Fujin's 
declaration of rivalry to meet at the 
"Satsuki Sho" through the screen.
